limitations: Concept-only review, not game integration, collision, native-grid, animation, physical safety or story-runtime validation.
Furniture and samples do not establish consent, actual payments, relocation, source disclosure or quest resolution.
Source appearance is not canon geography or a final identity/age model.

findings.finding: Two distinct wood samples, unstrung curved jig, front observer safety rope, covered pattern, blank attribution tag and closed cabinet appear. Public exterior approach to right room is independent of left test area. Front rope cordons the entire test frontage; operator access, safe release direction and measurable clearances still need a real layout. Left shed roof is omitted. Generated EED-D04-A/B captions violate the no-label prompt and should be removed before sprite extraction. Blank tag lies beside cloth, not beneath its flap; actual identifying text must stay concealed absent permission. No secret plan is legible. Material testing and family/identity disclosure remain separate permissions; no felling, permission or workshop closure is implied.

Exactly four separate full-body figures show two distinct adult-proportioned women, each in neutral and sample-holding poses. Left Sujin proposal retains head wrap, grey hair and olive long tunic; right Geli proposal retains dark braid, rust tunic and trousers. Hands hold detached wood samples, without bowstring, arrow or weapon. This is consistent with the source identifying Geli as the same adult niece/apprentice, not a child or a second person per task. Appearance and relative age styling are original proposals; the pixels alone do not prove biography or numerical ages. Fine shading and tall illustrated figures do not meet the requested roughly 40-logical-pixel native-sprite target; needs separate native-grid/palette/animation production.

Compared directly with batch22 original: left courtyard gate leaf now rests along the inside right edge, leaving a visibly clear paved opening from sorting corridor to exterior. This resolves the stated closed-gate target at concept scale. Right room retains separate front and side exits; broad document/ash/brazier arrangement remains, with no flame or exposed names. Whole-image re-render differences exist; do not claim pixel-exact preservation, final collision widths or a legal/physical safety certification. Prefer this version only for its narrow open-exit fix; retain v1.

overall: 89 v2 passes its narrow open-exit target; 94 supports two distinct adult character proposals. 93 remains a review concept with roof, labels, privacy-tag and physical-layout production caveats.
